products.name: UniVerse
products.subtitle: Campus Dining & Multi-Vendor OS
products.tagline: Eliminating campus dining wait times with real-time QR ordering, automated kitchen dispatching, and vendor split settlements.
products.lead: Architected & Built as Co-Founder (Engineering, Growth & Finance)
highlights: Socket.io WebSocket channels synchronize student clients, kitchen POS terminals, and Telegram alert bots simultaneously.
Razorpay payment integration with webhook idempotency keys to eliminate duplicate charge risks, supporting automatic split settlements.
Role-based portals separating Super-Admins, Vendor Kitchens, and Students with Groq AI-powered order insights.
Scalable PERN architecture hosted on AWS EC2, AWS RDS PostgreSQL with connection pooling, and AWS S3 object storage.

products.name: ChatLeads AI
products.subtitle: Fleet WhatsApp CRM & Multimodal OCR
products.tagline: Real-time WhatsApp fleet CRM with Gemini 2.5 Flash OCR and Groq Llama-4 automated lead extraction.
highlights: Architected multi-session WhatsApp fleet engine supporting 50+ concurrent instances via Baileys SDK and WebSockets.
Integrated Gemini 2.5 Flash for multimodal document OCR and Groq Llama-4 for intelligent structured lead parsing from PDFs and photos.
Engineered multi-tenant PostgreSQL backend with Pandas & OpenPyXL automated reporting modules.
Secure JWT authentication and live agent monitoring with zero dropped message events.

products.name: ABV — SkillPort
products.subtitle: Vocational Institute Platform & Digital Verification
products.tagline: Vocational institute management platform automating student workflows with JWT-secured digital certificate verification.
highlights: Developed end-to-end MERN management suite automating admissions, student records, document pipelines, and priority notice broadcasts.
Implemented JWT-secured digital certificate verification portal assigning unique verifiable IDs, reducing manual verification overhead by 40%.
Engineered multi-tier RBAC dashboards tailored for administrators, teaching staff, and enrolled students.
Delivered verified commercial project generating ₹1.1 Lakh revenue with 100% client satisfaction.

products.name: Nexus CRM
products.subtitle: High-Performance Multi-Tenant Event Engine
products.tagline: High-performance multi-tenant CRM with Redis event bus, chunked bulk imports, and automated appointment reminders.
highlights: Engineered multi-tenant CRM with 4 role tiers (SuperAdmin, Admin, TeamLead, Agent) using Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL JSONB.
Real-time lead assignment and dynamic callback notifications orchestrated via Socket.io and Redis low-latency event bus.
Chunked 1,000-record CSV/Excel bulk import engine improving database ingestion speed by 70% across 100k+ customer records.
Automated Brevo SMTP scheduling pipelines dispatching 1,000+ daily appointment reminders without thread blocking.

products.name: CampXChange
products.subtitle: Campus Circular Marketplace & Sharing OS
products.tagline: A student-focused marketplace helping college students buy, sell, exchange, and rent pre-owned products within their campus.
highlights: Comprehensive campus circular ecosystem: peer-to-peer buy & sell, zero-cost direct exchange, and term-based equipment rentals.
Student credibility safeguarded through institutional email domain authentication and AI-assisted student ID verification.
Integrated in-app real-time buyer-seller chat, custom wishlists, and community reporting mechanisms for inappropriate listings.
Engineered with Django backend, MongoDB document storage, and native Android Kotlin application.

products.name: SachiKheti
products.subtitle: Agri-Commerce Platform & Superadmin ERP
products.tagline: Direct-to-consumer agri-commerce platform and internal ERP portal for certified farm products with custom SVG analytics.
highlights: Trilingual storefront typography (English, Punjabi/Gurmukhi, Hindi) celebrating authentic agricultural heritage.
Standalone role-based Superadmin Portal (/adminlog) with JWT authentication and full CRUD across products, orders, and promotional ribbons.
Custom SVG business intelligence dashboards visualizing order fulfillment funnels, sales comparisons, and payment channel share.
Seamless dual-channel checkout supporting Razorpay UPI transactions and WhatsApp direct click-to-order with pre-filled cart payloads.
